r13_contract.comparisonModel: The lower end of the strengthened part of a main frame and of an intermediate ice frame shall be attached to a deck, top or bottom plating of a tank, tank top or an ice stringer (section 4.5). Where an intermediate frame terminates below a deck, top or bottom plating of a tank, tank top or ice stringer which is situated at or below the lower limit of the ice belt (section 4.3.1), the lower end may be connected to the adjacent main frames by a horizontal member of the same scantlings as the main frames. Note that the main frames below the lower edge of the ice belt must be ice strengthened, see 4.4.1.

test_cases.rationale: Lower end is attached to a deck.
Lower end is attached to a tank top.
Lower end is attached to an ice stringer.
Intermediate-frame lower termination uses the permitted horizontal-member route and adjacent main frame remains ice-strengthened.
No permitted lower-end attachment is present.
Lower end is attached only to a generic unsupported structure type.
Intermediate lower-end exception has a horizontal member with non-matching scantlings.
Adjacent main frame below the ice belt is not ice-strengthened.
